st_0006.speaker: Manager
st_0006.text: Could you introduce yourself to the camera for a minute?

st_0007.speaker: Hina
st_0007.text: What is this? Kinda suspicious... Well, okay.

st_0008.speaker: Hina
st_0008.text: Let me introduce myself properly. I'm Hina Hoshino.

st_0009.speaker: Hina
st_0009.text: I'm 22 years old, and my blood type is B!

st_0010.speaker: Hina
st_0010.text: ...Wait, do people really need to know my blood type?

st_0011.speaker: Hina
st_0011.text: Well, I guess that's what introductions are like.

st_0012.speaker: Hina
st_0012.text: Let's see... My birthday is July 22, and I'm a Cancer.

st_0013.speaker: Hina
st_0013.text: I was born in summer, but I'm actually not great with the summer heat.

st_0014.speaker: Hina
st_0014.text: When it gets hot, I end up eating ice cream all the time.

st_0015.speaker: Hina
st_0015.text: I complain that it'll make me gain weight, then eat it anyway.

st_0016.speaker: Hina
st_0016.text: I'm 158 centimeters tall. Pretty normal, right?

st_0017.speaker: Hina
st_0017.text: People do tell me my bust isn't exactly average, though.

st_0018.speaker: Hina
st_0018.text: It's one of my secret weapons! ...Just kidding.

st_0019.speaker: Hina
st_0019.text: Let's not dwell on that. It's embarrassing.

st_0020.speaker: Hina
st_0020.text: My hobbies are gaming and going around trying good food!

st_0021.speaker: Hina
st_0021.text: Lately I'm into having ramen at night and then getting dessert.

st_0022.speaker: Hina
st_0022.text: It's bad for my wallet and my figure, but great for happiness.

st_0023.speaker: Hina
st_0023.text: I wouldn't exactly call it a special talent, but...

st_0024.speaker: Hina
st_0024.text: I'm pretty good with TVs and video equipment.

st_0025.speaker: Hina
st_0025.text: I know quite a bit about new gadgets and wiring, too.

st_0026.speaker: Hina
st_0026.text: I'm actually pretty good at figuring things out.

st_0028.speaker: Hina
st_0028.text: The other day I got the change wrong and the Manager had to save me...

st_0031.speaker: Hina
st_0031.text: I love it spicy or mild.

st_0032.speaker: Hina
st_0032.text: What I can't stand is eggplant.

st_0033.speaker: Hina
st_0033.text: No matter how hard I try, eggplant is just impossible for me.

st_0036.speaker: Hina
st_0036.text: Fruit liqueurs, cocktails... sweet drinks like those.

st_0037.speaker: Hina
st_0037.text: Manager, want to go out for drinks sometime?

st_0038.speaker: Hina
st_0038.text: But careful. If I drink too much, I get really clingy.

st_0039.speaker: Hina
st_0039.text: So don't get mad if I latch onto you, okay?

st_0040.speaker: Hina
st_0040.text: And of course, I call you 'Manager.'

st_0042.speaker: Hina
st_0042.text: I'm really happy everyone gets along with me.

st_0043.speaker: Hina
st_0043.text: Though sometimes they tell me I lean on people too much.

st_0044.speaker: Hina
st_0044.text: I can't help it. I'm a softie.

st_0045.speaker: Hina
st_0045.text: Oh, and here's my unexpected side!

st_0046.speaker: Hina
st_0046.text: Believe it or not, I'm actually pretty resourceful.

st_0047.speaker: Hina
st_0047.text: I'm good at finding little tricks and shortcuts.

st_0048.speaker: Hina
st_0048.text: I do get told off if I try that when I should be serious, so I'm careful.

st_0051.speaker: Hina
st_0051.text: You can keep spoiling me as much as you want, you know?

st_0052.speaker: Hina
st_0052.text: I'm kidding... though maybe I'm not. Hehe.

st_0053.speaker: Hina
st_0053.text: Once again, nice to meet you, Manager!

st_0054.text: (Hina's introduction has been added to your memories.)
